items.title: Trestle Bio Announces Research Collaboration with Humacyte
items.summary: SAN DIEGO [March 6, 2025] - Trestle Biotherapeutics, Inc., today announced a research collaboration with Humacyte, Inc. (Nasdaq: HUMA), a commercial-stage biotechnology platform company developing universally implantable, bioengineered human tissue at commercial scale. The post Trestle Bio Announces Research Collaboration with Humacyte first appeared on Trestle Biotherapeutics .

items.title: Trestle Biotherapeutics Wins Prestigious KidneyX Prize
items.summary: SAN DIEGO [June 12, 2023] – Trestle Biotherapeutics today received a $1 million prize from the KidneyX Innovation Accelerator through the organization’s Artificial Kidney Prize program. Trestle is one of eight Artificial Kidney Prize Phase 2 winners announced today. The post Trestle Biotherapeutics Wins Prestigious KidneyX Prize first appeared on Trestle Biotherapeutics .

items.title: Trestle Biotherapeutics Announces Formation of Advisory Board
items.summary: SAN DIEGO [February 23, 2022] – Trestle Biotherapeutics, a private, San Diego-based company developing bioengineered therapies for patients living with kidney failure has today announced the formation of its advisory board. The Trestle Advisory Board is a balanced mix of academic and industry leaders who are world renowned scientific experts in the fields of 3D biofabrication, stem cell and developmental biology, tissue engineering, immunology, and nephrology. The post Trestle Biotherapeutics Announces Formation of Advisory Board first appeared on Trestle Biotherapeutics .

items.title: Trestle Biotherapeutics Announces License Agreement with Kumamoto University for Key Stem Cell Biology Technology for Regenerative Medicine
items.summary: SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Trestle Biotherapeutics, a private company based in San Diego, today announced that it has entered into a license agreement with Kumamoto University. Under the agreement, Trestle will gain access to foundational methods for the generation of specialized kidney cell types from human pluripotent stem cells. The post Trestle Biotherapeutics Announces License Agreement with Kumamoto University for Key Stem Cell Biology Technology for Regenerative Medicine first appeared on Trestle Biotherapeutics .

items.title: Trestle Biotherapeutics Licenses Innovations from Harvard University to Develop 3D Biofabricated Tissues to Treat Kidney Failure
items.summary: SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Trestle Biotherapeutics, a private company based in San Diego, today announced that it has entered into a license agreement with Harvard University. Under the agreement, Trestle will commercialize a suite of stem cell- and 3D biofabrication-based regenerative medicine technologies developed at Harvard’s Wyss Institute for Biologically Inspired Engineering, Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences (SEAS), and Brigham and Women’s Hospital. The post Trestle Biotherapeutics Licenses Innovations from Harvard University to Develop 3D Biofabricated Tissues to Treat Kidney Failure first appeared on Trestle Biotherapeutics .

items.title: Trestle Biotherapeutics Backed by Y Combinator
items.summary: Trestle Biotherapeutics is now backed by Y Combinator (YC), an elite start up accelerator that has launched more than 3000 companies, including Stripe, Airbnb, DoorDash, Coinbase, Instacart, Dropbox, Ginkgo Bioworks, and 64x Bio. Trestle accepted YC’s invitation to join the Winter 2021 cohort, and will be working directly with YC Partners Jared Friedman, Surbhi Sarna, and Tim Brady.
